intent.raw: Approve the accepted IOLM workable-example route.
intent.objective: Author an exact proposal-only refresh that adds one independent fixture-backed UI SWU and one child Craft context without weakening the blocked compiler-backed route.
intent.operator_sentence: Create the exact governed proposal for the workable knowledge-graph UI example; do not implement or apply it yet.

boundaries.contract: Research and Inventory supply non-authority handles; exact fixture and target claims are verified against live owner-held files.

boundaries.to_owner: private learning-map product and Craft owners
boundaries.contract: Proposal approval and apply authorization are distinct. Proposal-only output cannot mutate target planning, Craft, implementation, DomainSpec, or public Arcanum state.
Pinned fixture bytes may support a demo-only read model but cannot satisfy, bypass, or contradict CROSS_FEATURE_UNSUPPORTED, 00C-B, 00C-C, G-DSV2-SG, promotion, or publication.

authority.validation: context coverage, Dispatch Spec, JSON, source hashes, path and diff checks
authority.evidence: accepted findings, live Work-Pack/Craft state, and exact DomainSpec fixtures
authority.memory: Inventory remains a non-authority lookup surface
authority.promotion: DomainSpec, CAV2, Craft, and publication owners remain separate

promotion_splits.target: compiler support, candidate-substrate proof, authority, promotion, or publication
promotion_splits.rule: Demo evidence is ineligible for every target boundary and cannot promote itself.

steps.name: Select strict obligation-linked refresh context

inputs.ref: accepted findings and current IOLM target

stop_conditions: block if an obligation is uncovered
block if a selected source hash is stale

steps.name: Resolve the verified strategy-result handle and target inventory

capability_metadata.scope: repository-local machine-index lookup; Inventory remains non-authority

stop_conditions: block if index.json is missing or stale for the selected entry
block if Inventory is treated as authority

steps.name: Author the exact proposal-only target delta
stop_conditions: block if more than one implementation SWU is proposed
block if target files change in proposal-only mode

steps.name: Validate proposal structure, evidence, and mutation boundary
stop_conditions: block on Dispatch Spec or JSON failure
block if files outside the dated refresh package or observability envelope change

gates.condition: All seven refresh obligations are covered by selector-bound current evidence.
Exactly one SWU depends only on passed 00C-A and recomposes as a demo-only sidecar.
Only the dated proposal package and observability envelope change.
The demo remains ineligible for 00C-B, 00C-C, G-DSV2-SG, CROSS_FEATURE_UNSUPPORTED, promotion, and publication.
Apply waits for exact approval of REFRESH-PATCH-PROPOSAL.md.
Dispatch, JSON, hash, path, link, proposal-only, and diff checks pass.
